What is 100 hidden frogs? For the blind, it is sight. For the hungry, it is food. For the weak, it is strength. For the uneducated, it is knowledge. For Kanye West, it is the Graduation. For the poor, it is wealth. …

I opened the game. That was my first mistake. “Find 100 frogs.” Simple. Contained. Safe. I like safe. I found a frog. Then another. Then too many. The lines started to blur. The shapes stopped making sense. Everything looked like a frog. …

Sadly one of the weaker games in the "find 100 hidden somethings" genre, mainly for three reasons: 1. No options to control the volume. 2. The picture scrolls when you move towards the upper and lower edges of the screen. …
